message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described facts.

Facts: Li, a financial audit department head, was responsible for auditing grain stations. He discovered that station manager Huang had embezzled public funds (misappropriated public money) 240+ million for personal use. Li, during 2013 and 2014 year-end checks, found the issue but did not report in meeting, only privately reminded Huang. Li's work is described as serious dereliction of duty. The prosecution wants to hold Li criminally responsible.

What crime corresponds to a public official who fails to perform duties, allowing embezzlement? In Chinese criminal law, there is "玩忽职守罪" (negligent dereliction of duty) or "滥用职权罪" (abuse of power). The description: "工作存在严重失职" suggests "玩忽职守罪" (negligent duty). Also there is "徇私舞弊" but that's for officials who collude. Here Li didn't collude, just failed to report. So the appropriate charge is "玩忽职守罪". In Chinese official labeling, they often use "玩忽职守罪". The examples in the dataset: they have "失职" maybe? Let's see earlier examples: In the dataset, they used "失火" for arson, "非法狩猎" etc. For similar case of failure to report, they might have "玩忽职守". Let's search memory: In Chinese criminal law, article 397 (now 397?) "玩忽职守罪" for public officials who neglect duty causing loss. So answer: [罪名]玩忽职守<eoa>

Check if any other charge: Could be "渎职" but official term is "玩忽职守". So single charge.
